title: undo
description: To the bridge on the WebSocket: the card's Undo, or Ask Claude to undo when nothing was recorded. Answered by a result with the tweak's number (not-undoable while it isn't finished or there's nothing to undo; undo-failed if a write failed, when nothing was changed). Then a tweak-undone event (every file written back), a tweak-undo-conflict event (nothing written: the session claiming the page reverses it by hand), or a tweak-status event while no session claims the page.
